summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) disclosing management's unaudited estimate of net asset value per share range for its common stock as of May 31, 2026. This is a routine NAV update by a closed-end fund and does not involve a transaction, strategic review, or governance change. No deal terms are present. The filing is informational only and does not constitute a special situation.
